thesis: The dominant five-year market structure is expected to be driven by overlapping capex cycles in AI compute, electricity/grid infrastructure, defence/supply-chain security and automation, with AI monetization shifting gradually from hardware scarcity toward productivity software, cybersecurity and robotics.

ranked_themes.structural_driver: AI/data-centre demand, electrification, manufacturing reshoring and aging grids create a physical bottleneck in generation interconnection, transmission, substations and power equipment.
ranked_themes.avoid_overgeneralization: Do not equate rising power demand with superior regulated-utility equity returns; capital intensity and regulation can dilute shareholder economics.

ranked_themes.structural_driver: AI compute density raises demand across accelerators, HBM, advanced foundry, packaging, networking and semiconductor manufacturing equipment.
ranked_themes.key_risk: Supply can eventually grow faster than demand, especially in memory and cyclical equipment; theme growth does not eliminate semiconductor cyclicality.

ranked_themes.structural_driver: Data-centre electricity consumption and accelerated-server density create bottlenecks in power distribution, cooling, backup power and interconnect.
ranked_themes.picks_and_shovels_logic: Infrastructure demand persists regardless of which model or application vendor wins, provided aggregate compute demand remains strong.

ranked_themes.structural_driver: NATO's multi-year defence spending commitment and production-capacity rebuilding imply a durable rearmament capex cycle rather than a short event trade.
AI agents, cloud workloads, data access and autonomous workflows expand attack surfaces and raise the value of consolidated security platforms and specialized AI-security controls.
Labour scarcity, wage pressure, reshoring and improving machine vision/inference economics increase the ROI of industrial automation.
24/7 data-centre load requires firm generation and grid support in addition to renewables; gas, nuclear, storage and microgrids can all participate.
Large unmet needs in obesity/metabolic disease and other specialty areas can compound independently of the industrial/AI cycle.
ranked_themes.note: No market-size forecast is promoted to fact here because this persistence step did not independently verify the earlier quantitative obesity-market estimate.

ranked_themes.structural_driver: As infrastructure matures, value capture should migrate toward workflow automation, agents and measurable productivity gains.
ranked_themes.key_risk: AI can commoditize incumbent seat-based SaaS features; application-layer winners require differentiated data, distribution or workflow control.

ranked_themes.structural_driver: Higher-for-longer nominal rates can support spreads and investment income for well-capitalized franchises, but credit and duration risk remain cyclical.
